players.product: OlympusMAX dry / adiabatic coolers and Marley Everest cooling towers for data-center heat rejection

quarterly_data.signal: SPX's second-quarter 2026 earnings release raised full-year 2026 guidance for the HVAC segment (cooling and heating products) to revenue of $1,955-$1,995 million (prior $1,840-$1,880 million) and segment income margin of 24.50%-25.00% (prior 24.25%-24.75%). Company-wide 2026 revenue guidance, which also includes the Detection & Measurement segment, was raised to $2.705 to $2.765 billion (prior $2.575 to $2.645 billion).
